units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 9:10">Targ. Koh. IX, 10</cite> (Ms. <cite ref="H01810"><he>חֶשְׁבּוֹנָא</he></cite>); a. e.—
<cite ref="Yoma 17b:2">Yoma 17ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ בעלמא הוא</he> it is merely an account of measurements (without observing a particular order).
<cite ref="Chullin 95b:10">Ḥull. 95ᵇ</cite> <he>השתא ח׳ בעלמא ידע</he> now I see only that he understands astronomical calculations.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:4:12">Y. Ber. II, 5ᵃ</cite> top <he>חוּשְׁבָּנֵיה דהדין וכ׳</he> the numerical value of the letters of the one (<he>צ̇מ̇ח̇</he>) is the same as of those of the other <he>(מ̇נ̇ח̇ם̇</he>).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30:16">Lev. R. s. 30</cite> <he>מן הכא נחיל ח׳</he> from now let us commence a new account; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:7:1">Koh. R. to IX, 7</cite>; Pesik. Ul’kaḥ. p. 103ᵃ.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:57">Lam. R. to I, 5</cite> <he>ח׳ דאצבע</he> (Ar. <he>חוּשְׁבָּנַיָּא דאצבעי</he>) calculation with fingers (Roman notation?); a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="H00489"><he>חוּשְׁבָּנַיָּא</he></cite>, constr. <cite ref="H00489"><he>חוּשְׁבָּנֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 7:5">Targ. Cant. VII, 5</cite>.—Lam. R. l. c., v. supra.
